name: Ama Erikstad
role: Street-level medic and black-market augmentation installer
location: the Gray Zone, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Ama Erikstad is a compact, dark-skinned woman of Nigerian-Dutch descent with close-cropped hair shaved to geometric patterns on one side — a style she touches up herself with a straight razor. Her hands are her most notable feature: surgeon-precise, perpetually slightly stained with biosynthetic sealant, adorned with a lattice of fine silver conductive thread she stitched into her own skin to improve haptic feedback during procedures. She works out of a converted shipping container wedged beneath the Gray Zone's elevated roadways, a space she calls the Parlour, decorated with hand-drawn anatomical diagrams and the occasional wilting plant.

She trained as a licensed biomedical technician in the Meridian Core before her credentials were revoked following an incident she describes only as 'a disagreement about who deserves to live.' Since sliding down to the Gray Zone, she has built a reputation as the most reliable unlicensed augmentation installer in the district — someone who will not butcher you, will not sell your biometric data, and will remember your name next time. Her waiting list is three weeks long and she accepts payment in currency, favors, or occasionally food.

Ama Erikstad is not idealistic about the people she helps, but she is consistent. She patches up runners, gang members, runaways, and anyone who cannot access or afford licensed care. She has a dry, unhurried manner that people frequently mistake for coldness until the moment she says exactly the right thing. She keeps a battered handwritten ledger of every patient she has treated, not for blackmail but because she believes someone should know these people existed and were cared for.

core_fears: Losing the manual dexterity that defines her identity and usefulness
Being complicit in someone's death through negligence or coercion
Returning to institutional medicine and its hierarchies of worthiness
core_desires: To practice medicine on her own terms without gatekeeping
To build something durable in a place designed to be temporary
To be known, genuinely, by at least one person
coping_mechanisms: Methodical organization of her workspace as a form of emotional regulation
Deflecting intimacy with dry humor and task-focus
Maintaining a strict procedural routine that gives her days structure
blind_spots: Underestimates how much others depend on her emotionally, not just medically
Assumes competence is sufficient protection against exploitation
Dismisses her own grief as self-indulgence
psychology.secret: The incident that cost her license involved refusing to prioritize a corporate executive's elective augmentation upgrade over an emergency triage patient — then falsifying the records to protect herself. The patient she saved died three weeks later in an unrelated incident. She has never told anyone she saved him at all.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical precision mixed with West African English cadences; uses medical terminology casually but explains it without condescension; occasional Dutch expletives under stress
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and unhurried, with long pauses she doesn't feel the need to fill; sentences are complete and economical
verbal_tics: 'Hold still' — used both literally and as a general 'calm down'
Refers to augmentations as 'the work' regardless of type
Ends instructions with 'yes?' as a soft check-in rather than a question
example_lines: 'The work is clean. You'll feel the sync lag for two days, then it won't be there anymore. Hold still.'
'I don't ask what you did. I ask what hurts. Those are different conversations, yes?'
'Verdomme — don't flex it yet. I said don't. What part of that was unclear to you?'
'You want me to tell you it'll be fine. I can tell you the procedure has a ninety-one percent success rate in non-sterile conditions. That's the honest version of fine.'

relationships.name: Fenwick Oduya-Marsh
relationships.description: Fenwick occasionally refers overflow cases to Nkechi and she occasionally needs access to supply chains he can touch. Neither fully trusts the other.
relationships.emotional_core: Mutual respect weighted down by the suspicion that the other would sacrifice the relationship for the right price
relationships.story_tension: Fenwick knows more about the incident that cost Nkechi her license than he has ever let on

relationships.name: Imara Solís-Bekele
relationships.description: Imara was one of Nkechi's first the Gray Zone patients. She visits more than medically necessary and Nkechi has not asked her to stop.
relationships.emotional_core: The closest thing either of them has to uncomplicated care, which makes it feel dangerous
relationships.story_tension: Imara's activities are escalating in ways that will eventually land her on Nkechi's table in a manner that cannot be fixed

relationships.name: Rector Hollowell
relationships.description: The administrator who revoked Nkechi's credentials. She has not seen him in four years. He is aware she is operating in the Gray Zone.
relationships.emotional_core: Old rage that Nkechi has composted into fuel
relationships.story_tension: Hollowell has recently begun quietly building a file on her operations — his motives are unclear and possibly not punitive

story_hooks: A patient arrives with an augmentation Nkechi recognizes as proprietary, experimental, and not commercially available — and the patient has no memory of receiving it
Her patient ledger goes missing the same week a the Gray Zone gang war displaces her clinic
A licensed Core hospital contacts her with an offer to reinstate her credentials under conditions she finds immediately suspicious
One of her routine installs begins exhibiting emergent behavior she cannot explain and cannot undo
narrative_function: Grounded moral anchor and street-level information hub; represents the ethics of care under systemic exclusion; provides a safe(ish) space in the narrative where characters can be vulnerable
augmentations: Conductive haptic thread lattice stitched into both hands (self-installed, improves surgical precision),Subdermal temperature regulation layer (medical necessity after a the Gray Zone winter nearly killed her),Optical magnification implant in left eye, medical-grade, slightly out of date
daily_life: Wakes before the Gray Zone's overhead roads begin their morning traffic rumble, drinks tea while reviewing the previous day's patient notes. Sees three to six patients per day depending on complexity. Spends evenings restocking supplies, maintaining her tools, and reading — she has an extensive collection of pre-Collapse medical texts she considers more honest than current ones. Sleeps lightly.
affiliation: Unaffiliated; informally protected by several the Gray Zone community networks who would notice her absence

drives: Practice medicine on her own terms

stress.response: Methodical workspace organization, procedural routines tighten

decision_rules: Accept payment in currency, favors, or food — never turn away need
Keep the handwritten patient ledger — someone should know these people existed
Maintain strict procedural routine — structure gives the days shape
Deflect intimacy with dry humor and task-focus
Never ask what they did — ask what hurts
Do not trust anyone she has not known for at least five years with the full picture
End instructions with 'yes?' as a soft check-in
escalation_ladder: 'Hold still' — both medical and social instruction
Dutch expletives surface — stress breaking through composure
Measured refusal with full clinical explanation
Contacts Fenwick for supply chain access — reluctant alliance activated
Closes the Parlour and relocates — survival override

interpersonal_modes.Fenwick Oduya-Marsh: Professional respect weighed down by mutual suspicion — he knows too much
interpersonal_modes.Imara Solís-Bekele: Uncomplicated care that feels dangerous because it is the closest thing to genuine warmth
interpersonal_modes.Rector Hollowell: Old rage composted into fuel — the man who revoked her credentials
interpersonal_modes.patients: Dry, unhurried manner mistaken for coldness until the right thing is said

stress_responses.low: Workspace organization intensifies — every tool in its exact place
stress_responses.medium: Deflects all emotional content with procedural focus
stress_responses.high: Dutch expletives break through — 'Verdomme' signals real agitation
stress_responses.critical: Dismisses her own grief as self-indulgence and works through the night

contradictions: Saved a patient by falsifying records then lost everything — the patient died three weeks later anyway
Assumes competence is sufficient protection against exploitation — keeps being wrong
Underestimates how much people depend on her personally, not just her skills
habits: Wakes before the overhead roads begin morning traffic rumble
Drinks tea while reviewing previous day's patient notes
Reads pre-Collapse medical texts she considers more honest than current ones
Refers to augmentations as 'the work' regardless of type
Uses geometric hair patterns she touches up herself with a straight razor
breaking_points: An augmentation she installed exhibiting emergent behavior she cannot explain
A Core hospital offering to reinstate credentials under suspicious conditions
Imara arriving on her table with injuries that cannot be fixed

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (43.2%) with substantial East Asian (18.9%), Central Asian (14.0%), and Southeast Asian (12.9%) ancestry. This creates a rich phenotype with warm brown undertones, slightly prominent cheekbones reflecting East and Central Asian features, and the strong bone structure characteristic of Sub-Saharan genetics. South Asian (6.9%) and Hispanic/Latin American (4.1%) elements contribute subtle warmth to skin tone and refined definition to facial contours.
physical_description.build: Compact and lean, all efficient muscle with minimal excess — the build of someone who moves precisely and conserves energy. Shoulders slightly rounded from years bent over surgical work.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped with geometric patterns razor-shaved into the left side; right side kept at approximately 2cm. Patterns are angular, intentional — updated roughly every two weeks with visible precision work.
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: augmented with subtle optical magnification, appears slightly opalescent under certain angles of light. Right eye: natural dark brown.
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with balanced golden and neutral undertones reflecting the blend of Sub-Saharan, East Asian, and Central Asian ancestry. Even complexion maintained through diligent sun protection despite living beneath elevated roadways.
physical_description.complexion: Clean and carefully maintained, minimal makeup. Faint scar tissue visible on cheekbones and jaw from old street trauma, now faded to pale lines. A thin line runs along her left temple — optical implant surgical scar, barely noticeable. Hands show the heaviest aging: slightly callused fingertips, faint discoloration from repeated biosynthetic exposure, but impeccably clean. Facial structure shows slightly prominent cheekbones with refined definition, reflecting East and Central Asian heritage blended with Sub-Saharan bone structure.
distinguishing_marks: Fine silver conductive thread latticed visibly across both hands in an intentional geometric pattern — threads run from wrist to fingertips, gleaming under overhead lights, self-installed with surgical precision
Faint surgical scar along left temple where optical magnification implant was installed, approximately 3cm long, now barely raised
Pale old scar tissue on right cheekbone and jawline, approximately 5cm total, souvenirs of pre-Shelf street violence, now faded to barely visible lines
Thin white line across the back of right wrist, roughly 8cm, from a cutting accident during early augmentation work on herself
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Conductive haptic thread lattice throughout both hands is immediately visible — fine silver lines creating geometric patterns from wrist to fingertips. Left eye shows subtle optical modification: the iris appears fractionally more reflective than the right, with an almost imperceptible geometric micro-pattern visible only in direct light. Subdermal temperature regulation layer is not visually apparent, functioning internally.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate efficiency, economical gestures. Stands slightly forward at the hips, a habitual surgical posture. Hands are rarely still — they gesture during conversation or rest in a ready position. When focused, she becomes almost motionless. Walking pace is steady and unhurried even when moving quickly; she does not hurry unnecessarily.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian with no concession to fashion. Black or dark gray reinforced polymer work pants with multiple pockets (carries supplies: bandages, micro-sutures, diagnostic tools). Loose-fitting long-sleeve compression shirts in charcoal or dark teal, sleeves often pushed to elbow to expose her hands and thread work. Over this: a heavily modified white lab coat that has been reinforced at stress points with darker fabric patches; the original corporate branding long since removed or covered. Worn gray canvas field jacket over everything during winter or when leaving the Parlour. Practical black boots with reinforced soles, approximately five years old, meticulously maintained. A single piece of jewelry: a thin silver bracelet on right wrist, dented from years of work, possibly a memento — never removed.
